latest_release.name: OpenBot v0.65.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Let users choose the spoken replies model: Supertonic, ElevenLabs or xAI by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5555
* Show which workflow branch has no answer at a model join by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5561
* Start dev builds with the Dynamic Island and agent dock off by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5562
* Add a setting to turn off the hold to quit on a Mac by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5566
* Use API credit for Claude agents on an Anthropic API key by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5571
* Open an agent page in the side panel and quote text from it by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5570
* Let users choose a chat background for Light and for Dark by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5577
* Give notifications a new look by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5576
* Make the chat send and the message box move as Grok Bot does by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5578
* Add "Delete history" to the agent and channel settings by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5579
* Add Mistral as a built-in provider through Mistral Vibe by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5582
* Show the selected sidebar row with a grey fill in the light theme by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5585
* Use one registry for side panel panes by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5587
* Open channel file links to files outside the agent workspace by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5588
* Add Groq Whisper as dictation models by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5586
* Put the Workspace only sandbox in the Claude settings file by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5597
* Make the agent browser use fewer turns by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5589
* Register MCP sign-in again with localhost when 127.0.0.1 is refused by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5599
* Let Codex live voice work with agents on joined servers by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5592
* Keep agent browser pages drawn while the macOS window is minimized or hidden by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5604
* Scroll the agent dock when it has too many agents by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5605
* Add a Library page to the window rail by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5606
* Hide the agent dock from window switchers on macOS by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5607
* Keep the AppImage updater beside a self-hosted server by @Absterrg0 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4341
* Make the triage skill rate UX impact for casual users by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5608
* Connect the host to Signal again when its socket does not answer by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5611
* Run the OpenCode canary case on a fake model on loopback by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5609
* Complete Gemini turns that end silently after output or optional reply by @matheustx017 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/5596
* fix(pi): send developer instructions to the Pi CLI in a file by @huajar in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/3777
* Ship Noto CJK fonts in the Docker image so the embedded browser renders CJK text by @sarequl in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/4442
* Show a white root on the agent display of a server by @NorbertBodz

detail.readme_excerpt:
# OpenBot

[![CI](https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-PolyForm_Noncommercial_1.0.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

OpenBot is a local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates. It supports the local
[Codex App Server](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/app-server) and
[Claude Code](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/overview), plus [Grok CLI](https://docs.x.ai/build/overview),
OpenCode, Gemini, [Cursor CLI](https://cursor.com/cli), [Cline CLI](https://cline.bot/cli), [Kimi Code CLI](https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli),
[Devin CLI](https://cli.devin.ai), [GitHub Copilot CLI](https://github.com/github/copilot-cli), [Mistral Vibe](https://github.com/mistralai/mistral-vibe), and [Hermes Agent](https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com) through ACP. It gives every agent its own workspace and
conversation, and provides local queues, file transfers, an embedded browser, and agent-to-agent
messaging in one desktop app.

OpenBot is ready for production use. A new release ships almost every day.

> [!WARNING]
> Agents run with `danger-full-access` and `approvalPolicy: never`. They can read and modify files,
> run commands, use the network, and control the embedded browser without per-action confirmations
> after the explicit first-launch consent.
> Run only agents and tasks you trust, keep backups, and review [Security](#security) before use.

## What works

- Prompt-driven agent creation and editing on desktop and mobile, with editable instructions, avatar, and section review before saving.
- Persistent agents backed by independent Codex, Claude, Grok, OpenCode, Gemini, Cursor, Cline, Kimi, Devin, GitHub Copilot, Mistral, or Hermes sessions and local workspaces.
- Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints and custom ACP agents, with detection of local model servers (Ollama, LM Studio) and installed agents.
- Per-agent context monitoring with automatic compaction before long threads exhaust the model window.
- FIFO message queues with pause, resume, cancellation, and crash-safe persistence.
- Agent-to-agent messages, replies, reactions, images, and managed file transfers.
- Shared desktop channel chats with one task owner, explicit delegation, shared history, and Stop, Resume, Reassign, Archive, and Restore controls.
- A persistent embedded browser that agents can open, inspect, and control.
- Optional Computer Use on macOS, Windows and Linux through the `cua-driver` binary in the release, which OpenBot starts as its own child process and gives to every provider.
- Per-agent model, reasoning, profile, notification, browser, and panel state.
- Local data and privacy-safe diagnostics exports from the account menu.
- Optional OpenBot accounts through one-time email codes. The account API runs on Cloudflare Workers and D1.

OpenBot is local-first, not offline-only. Codex connects to OpenAI, Claude connects to Anthropic,
G
